record.question: Which of the following is not included under the five rights to prevent administrative error?
record.explanation: Answer D: The right administrator. The five rights include right patient, drug, dose, route, and time; “right administrator” is not one of the standard five. Source/context note: Many safety frameworks expand the list beyond five rights; the question specifically asks the traditional five. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241511643. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
